name: Tokyo's Twenty-Three Wards
description: One address in each of Tokyo's 23 special wards (特別区), mostly ward offices and well-known blocks, written in full; then a few without 東京都, where the ward alone names the prefecture. Original case written for this corpuss; shapes follow Japan Post's guidance on writing an address (郵便番号・住所の書き方), described in our own words; nothing copied.
